items.title: Uber Moves beyond CPU Cores with Performance-Aware Scheduling for Stateful Workloads
items.summaryShort: Uber Moves beyond CPU Cores with Performance-Aware Scheduling for Stateful Workloads. Uber has introduced Normalized Compute Units (NCUs) to make CPU allocation more consistent across its highly heterogeneous server fleet.
